title: Per-instance CPU executed-cycle counter and target clock
body: ICpu exposes ExecutedCycles and TargetClockHz per instance; MachineState carries a per-CPU breakdown; UpdatePerformanceCounters uses the primary CPU executed cycles divided by its target clock.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ICpu exposes a per-instance ExecutedCycles counter and TargetClockHz.
MachineState carries a per-CPU breakdown (id, executedCycles, targetHz) for host and peripheral CPUs.
